empty.title: Connect your first WABA number
empty.message: Connect a WhatsApp Business number to send template messages, broadcasts and flows from this workspace.

notReady.title: Embedded Signup is not configured
notReady.message: Ask the platform admin to set: {missing}. You can still connect with a pasted token.
notReady.messageGeneric: Ask the platform admin to finish the Meta app setup. You can still connect with a pasted token.

card.notOnCloudHint: Meta reports this number on the retired On-Premises API (shut down 23 Oct 2025). Verify it and register it on the Cloud API in WhatsApp Manager, then connect it again.
card.inboundWiredHint: Meta delivers this number's incoming messages here.
card.inboundNotWiredHint: Incoming messages are not reaching this platform. Click Fix inbound.
card.inboundUnknownHint: Not checked yet. Open Health or click Fix inbound.

confirm.fixInboundMessage: Use this when incoming messages are not arriving. The number is re-subscribed to this platform's webhook and checked again.
confirm.disconnectMessage: Sending and receiving stop and the stored token is wiped. The number stays in the list until you remove it.
confirm.removeMessage: The number is deleted from this workspace. Broadcasts that used it keep their history.

registerDialog.title: Register on the Cloud API
registerDialog.message: Enter the number's 6-digit two-step verification PIN if it has one. Leave blank to use the stored PIN or a new one.

connect.embeddedIntro: Meta hands this platform a token that only lets it send and receive messages for the number you pick. You can revoke it at any time in Meta Business Suite.
connect.sdkFailed: The Facebook SDK could not be loaded. Check your connection or ad blocker, or use manual mode.
connect.notConfigured: Embedded Signup is not configured. Ask the platform admin.
connect.cancelled: Meta sign-up was cancelled. Nothing was connected.
connect.noNumber: You did not select a phone number. Pick one in the Meta window, or use manual mode.
connect.noSession: Meta returned a login but no WABA or phone number. Finish the number step in the Meta window, or use manual mode.
connect.metaErrorGeneric: Meta reported an error during sign-up.
connect.manualInfo: Find these in Meta Business Suite › WhatsApp Manager › API Setup. The token must include whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management.
connect.accessTokenHint: Use a permanent System User token; 24-hour tokens stop working tomorrow.
connect.verifyGood: Token looks good – safe to connect.
connect.verifyBad: Problems found – fix these before connecting.
connect.launchCoexistence: Connect my existing Business App number
connect.coexistenceNote: Scan the QR code Meta shows in its window from the WhatsApp Business app. Sending is capped at about 5 messages a second, there is no blue tick, and linked devices are unlinked while the number is connected.

health.loadFailed: Could not read this number's health.
health.limitHint: Unique customers you can start per day
health.replaceTokenHint: Paste a fresh System User token. Meta must accept it before it is saved.
health.notRead: Could not be read from Meta.
health.readErrors: Could not read some data from Meta

errors.WABA_NOT_CONFIGURED: Embedded Signup is not configured on this platform.
errors.WABA_MISSING_PERMISSION: The token is missing the whatsapp_business_management permission. Regenerate the System User token with that scope.
errors.WABA_NUMBER_IN_USE: This number is already connected to another workspace.
errors.WABA_ID_MISMATCH: The ids Meta returned do not belong to this login. Start again.
errors.WABA_ON_PREMISE: This number is still on the retired On-Premises API. Register it on the Cloud API in WhatsApp Manager, then connect again.
errors.WABA_NO_WABA: Meta did not return a WhatsApp Business Account for this login.
errors.WABA_NO_PHONE: This WhatsApp Business Account has no phone number yet.
errors.WABA_NO_CREDENTIALS: No access token is stored for this number. Replace the token on its health page.
errors.WABA_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: Meta could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.

profile.title: Business profile
profile.aboutHint: Shown under the name in the chat header (1–139 characters).
profile.websiteScheme: Websites must start with http:// or https://

extras.freeHintPaid: Free service conversations left, {used} used, {paid} paid
extras.verifiedActive: Active - your number shows the verified badge
extras.verifiedHint: Meta grants the badge manually, for brand notability or Meta Verified. There is no way to apply from here; the four checks are for your information.
extras.usernameHint: A public @handle so customers can find you without your number. Claiming one does not hide your phone number.
extras.usernameReserved: Reserved - activates when WhatsApp rolls out usernames
extras.usernameReleaseConfirm: Release this username? Someone else may take it.
extras.usernameRules: 3-24 characters - lowercase letters, numbers, . and _ - must contain a letter, no leading or trailing dot, not starting with www or ending like a web address.
extras.qrHint: A QR code and short link that open a chat with your number and a ready-made message.
extras.qrPlaceholder: Hi! I would like to know more
extras.qrDeleteConfirm: Delete this QR code? Printed copies will stop working.
extras.syncHint: Meta pushes your phone's recent chat history once, after onboarding. This asks again. Standard Cloud API numbers have no history.
extras.syncConfirm: Ask Meta to push the last months of chat history again?
extras.syncDone: Requested a fresh history sync from Meta. Messages arrive over the next few minutes.
extras.syncDoneCount: Requested a fresh history sync from Meta. {count} historical messages already imported; more may arrive over the next few minutes.
extras.inboundHint: Asks Meta which apps this WhatsApp account is subscribed to and where it delivers messages right now.
extras.verdict_not_subscribed: No app is subscribed to this WhatsApp account, so nothing is delivered here. Click Fix inbound.
extras.verdict_wrong_url: Meta delivers this number's messages to a different address. Click Fix inbound to point them here.
extras.verdict_delivering_here: Meta delivers this number's messages to this platform.
extras.verdict_subscribed_default: An app is subscribed and uses its default callback. If you connected through your own Meta app, make sure that app's callback is the address below.
extras.noSecret: Neither this number nor the platform has an app secret, so a signed message from Meta cannot be proven. Add the app secret in the platform settings.
extras.inboundConfirm: To confirm, send a message to this number from another phone and check that it appears in the inbox.
extras.ownAppHint: Paste these two values into your app's WhatsApp configuration (callback URL and verify token), and subscribe it to the messages field.

customers.title: Saved customers
customers.intro: Pre-set a customer's name, company and delivery address. When they order on WhatsApp, their details are shown and they just reply YES.
customers.name: Name
customers.search: Search by name, phone or company
customers.empty: No saved customers yet. Add one above.
customers.saved: Customer saved. Their address will auto-fill when they order on WhatsApp.
customers.removed: Customer removed. Their orders are kept.
customers.confirmMessage: The saved name, company and address are deleted. Their orders stay in the order list.
customers.invalidPhone: Enter a valid phone number (with country code).
